Feedback

Report a problem, describe an accessibility barrier or suggest a useful improvement. The feedback route is structured and moderated rather than an anonymous public comment box.

Use the feedback form

The form opens on GitHub. GitHub sign-in is required before anything can be submitted. That blocks automated anonymous posting, keeps the site from exposing an email address, and gives each report a reviewable record.

Open the feedback form

Include useful evidence

  • Choose one category and name the tab or feature involved.
  • Describe what you did, what you expected and what actually happened.
  • Add the browser, device and whether MIDI was connected when relevant.
  • For accessibility reports, state the input method or assistive technology involved.
  • Do not include passwords, private scores, email addresses, MIDI serial numbers or other personal information.

Privacy boundary: Notation Lab does not receive a message from this page. The page only links to the repository's GitHub Issue Form; your report is sent only if you sign in and submit it there. Practice progress and MIDI input remain browser-local.
